edges.reason: Constructor stores the untrusted msg.sender as creatorAddress, the root of all authorization
creatorAddress is initialized by the constructor
onlyCREATOR requires msg.sender == creatorAddress before addSERAPHIM executes
creatorAddress is read inside the onlyCREATOR modifier of addSERAPHIM
onlyCREATOR gate on removeSERAPHIM uses msg.sender
creatorAddress read inside onlyCREATOR of removeSERAPHIM
onlyCREATOR gate on updateMaintenanceMode uses msg.sender
creatorAddress read inside onlyCREATOR of updateMaintenanceMode
onlyCREATOR function writes the isMaintenanceMode pause flag
onlySERAPHIM trusts seraphims[msg.sender] membership for privilege checks
addSERAPHIM accepts an arbitrary caller-supplied address parameter
_newSeraphim is written into the seraphims whitelist without validation
addSERAPHIM performs the unchecked increment of totalSeraphims
Unchecked increment writes the uint16 totalSeraphims counter
removeSERAPHIM performs the unchecked decrement of totalSeraphims
Unchecked decrement writes the uint16 totalSeraphims counter
totalSeraphims is increased when a seraphim is added
totalSeraphims is decreased when a seraphim is removed
Pseudo-randomness in getRandomNumber derives from block context, timestamps and addresses
Strike obtains its damage value from getRandomNumber
Strike returns the computed damage to fightTeams
fightTeams calls Strike for each round of combat
fightTeams assigns the Strike() result to the strike local variable used in HP subtraction
randomPetAuraBoost uses getRandomNumber to pick an aura colour
The chance local variable is produced from getRandomNumber inside randomPetAuraBoost
chance controls which aura branch of randomPetAuraBoost is executed
msg.sender is passed as the private seed into getRandomNumber calls from fightTeams
move() authorizes the caller against the current turn owner (msg.sender != getTurn)
move() depends on block timestamp for the turn delay bypass (now < lastMoveTime + 3600*delayHours)
battleboardDataContract address is read by move() to build the external interface
move() issues numerous external calls to the battleboard data contract
move() performs a long sequence of external contract calls while tile and turn state is only partially updated
move() calls fightTeams when a team tile collides with another team
move() calls checkMonsterAttack after relocating the tile
move() calls removeDeadTurns to skip dead players' turns
move() validates the requested destination with canMove
positionTo parameter is consumed by the canMove validation inside move()
canMove relies on safeSubtract for position arithmetic (position1-1, -2, -8, -16)
canMove queries tile occupancy from the battleboard data contract
checkMonsterAttack triggers fightMonster when a monster is within range
fightTeams calls getFastest to determine initiative order
getFastest reads tile speed values from the battleboard data contract
removeDeadTurns reads turn, tile id and liveness from the battleboard data contract
fightMonster reads tile HP and kills tiles/monsters through the battleboard data contract
fightTeams reads tile stats and writes tile HP through the battleboard data contract
fightTeams performs unchecked hp - strike subtractions
fightMonster performs unchecked hp - monsterHit subtraction
strike damage value is applied in the unchecked HP subtraction
monsterHit local is produced from getRandomNumber(maxMonsterHit, minMonsterHit, msg.sender)
monsterHit is the subtrahend of the unchecked HP subtraction
move() calls angelCardData.addToAngelExperienceLevel on experience boost tiles
move() calls medalData._createMedal (external call) while the turn and tile state are still unsettled
move() calls isVulnerable to resolve barrier trap damage
randomPetAuraBoost calls petCardData.setPetAuras on an external contract
_boost parameter is added to the selected pet aura inside randomPetAuraBoost
getAngelInfoByTile reads battle power and aura from the angel data contract
getAuraColor reads the angel aura from the angel data contract
fightMonster checks the angel aura colour for monster immunity
isVulnerable reads the angel aura from the angel data contract
onlyCREATOR gate on DataContacts, the setters of the trusted external contract addresses

onlyCREATOR can repoint petCardDataContract to an arbitrary address
onlyCREATOR can repoint medalDataContract to an arbitrary address
onlyCREATOR can repoint battleboardDataContract to an arbitrary address
onlyCREATOR gate on setVariables, which changes battle parameters
onlyCREATOR writes delayHours which controls the timestamp-based turn bypass
onlyCREATOR writes petHpThreshold used by Strike
onlyCREATOR writes maxMonsterHit used as randomness bound
onlyCREATOR writes minMonsterHit used as randomness bound
onlyCREATOR gate on the destructive kill() function
kill() executes selfdestruct, irreversibly destroying the contract
selfdestruct forwards the remaining balance to creatorAddress
creatorAddress is the beneficiary of the selfdestruct in kill()
onlyCREATOR gate on withdrawEther
creatorAddress is both the authorization check and the transfer target of withdrawEther
withdrawEther performs an external balance transfer to creatorAddress (untrusted IF creator is a contract)

The medal contract _createMedal call can re-enter move() before turn/tile state is finalized
